why: The goal asks every iteration to report the Marble ID and cost. Those
numbers lived in conversation, which means they were re-derived from
memory each time and could not be checked by anyone else.
This file holds ONLY what a world manifest cannot know: the opening
balance, what the founder decided about each world, and any charge that
did not produce a world. Every credit figure itself is read out of the
manifests, because a second copy of a number is a second number.
opening_note: The founder's stated starting credits when the Marble goal was set.

last_observed_balance.how: reported by the API on the completed HQ mesh export and recorded in the royal-garden-backdrop manifest
last_observed_balance.note: Reconciled against the derived total by ledger.py. A mismatch is a REFUSAL, not a rounding note — it means a charge happened that nothing here recorded.

royal-garden.why: Marble reproduced the Relay Dogs out of the reference image despite an explicit NO-DOGS text prompt. Image conditioning beat the negative. Nothing from this world is used.
royal-garden.decided_by: the agent, against the goal's explicit rule that Marble must not generate Relay Dogs

royal-garden-backdrop.why: Generated from the reference cropped above the dog band. Dog-free. The HQ mesh export from this world is what the UE import stages.
royal-garden-backdrop.decided_by: the agent; NO MERGE until founder visual approval
